title: [Interview] ‘Whenever we take pro-European political decisions, Russia cut or reduced gas supplies’. Moldova energy minister Dorin Junghietu on why Chișinău is betting on diversification
lede: Moldova suffers from soaring blackout costs and fragile Soviet-era lines. Chisinau, in response, on Monday, inaugurated a new electric grid, linking to Romania and the European grid. The country's energy minister tells EUobserver: 'Russia uses energy as a weapon, and they did it also to Moldova. Whenever we tried to take pro-European political decisions, Russia cut or reduced gas supplies.'

title: Fake bomb warnings are hitting European aviation – but the bigger threat came from Jared Kushner
lede: Every one of the 70-plus warnings sent to airlines, newsrooms and other targets in Europe last week was a hoax. But the harm was real: planes diverted, buildings evacuated, plans disrupted, costs incurred, public confidence eroded, writes Edward Lucas.
